items.title: Volaris Reports Decrease in Consolidated Load Factor for August
items.summary: VLRS saw August traffic rise 15.4% year over year, while capacity grew 15.8%, pushing consolidated load factor down 0.3 points to 84.4%.

items.title: JetBlue to Lure Customers With Its Advanced First Class Services
items.summary: JBLU's BlueFirst is expected to add premium seating, upgraded tech, priority perks and enhanced hospitality as part of its JetForward strategy.

items.title: Old Dominion Unveils Solid LTL Unit Performance for August
items.summary: ODFL's August LTL revenue per day rose 12.4% year over year as higher revenue per hundredweight offset a 0.9% drop in tons per day.

items.title: Why Is Expeditors International (EXPD) Up 2.6% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Expeditors International (EXPD) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: RYAAY August Traffic Remains Flat Sequentially, FY27 Traffic View Down
items.summary: Ryanair's August traffic rose 6% year over year but stayed flat sequentially, while its fiscal 2027 traffic forecast was reduced to 214 million passengers.

items.title: Expeditors (EXPD) Stock Looks Above Fair Value After Its 68% Run
items.summary: Expeditors International of Washington stock has delivered a strong multi year gain, while both the intrinsic value estimate and market based checks currently point to an expensive entry point. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model indicates that the shares trade at a premium to intrinsic value, and the broader valuation checks do not flag the stock as a bargain. items.title: Air Freight and Logistics Q2 Earnings: Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) Simply the Best
items.summary: Quarterly earnings results are a good time to check in on a company’s progress, especially compared to its peers in the same sector. Today we are looking at Expeditors (NYSE:EXPD) and the best and worst performers in the air freight and logistics industry.

items.title: United Airlines Expands Globally With 10 New International Cities
items.summary: UAL expands globally with 10 new international cities, new Europe-Asia routes and the A321XLR rollout supporting 2027 growth.
